text: The Medical Officer of Health will give a presentation on Toronto Public Health Strategic Planning.

The Board of Health: 1. Established a Board of Health - Strategic Plan Development Committee. 2. Approved the Terms of Reference as detailed in Attachment 1 to the motion by Councillor Chris Moise. 3. Appointed the following Board of Health Directors to the Board of Health - Strategic Plan Development Committee for a term of office ending upon the completion of the Committee's mandate or the end of the current City Council term, whichever comes first: Director Alejandra Bravo, as the Committee Chair Director Amber Morley Director Anu Sriskandarajah Director Abinaya Chandrabalan Director Charles Ozzoude 4. Directed the Board of Health - Strategic Plan Development Committee to meet at the call of the Chair.
